messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] structured and unstructured temporal of BYM model
parts:
On Mon, 2019-06-24 at 04:08 -0700, WenQian Dong wrote:
> formula.st <- count ~ 1 + X1+ X2 + ... + X8 +
> f(ID.area,model = "bym", graph = studyarea.adj, constr = F) +
> f(ID.area.wday, model="rw1") +
> f(ID.area.wday1, model="iid", constr = TRUE) +
> f(ID.area.hour, model="iid", constr = TRUE)
>
> note that:
> 1. wday is Monday to Sunday set as 1 to 7.
> 2. hour is fourteen hours set as 7 to 20.


it looks correct to me.

I would used

f(ID.area.wday,model="rw1", cyclic = TRUE, scale.model=TRUE)

since you're on the week, then end of the week should also be neigb to
the beginning of the week (cyclic=TRUE), and I would always scale (by
scale.model=TRUE) the intrinsic models.

> inla.emarginal(mean, marg)
>

I'm not sure this is correct if vectorized, better to say

inla.emarginal(function(x) x, marg)

if 'x' is length two, then first argument will return 'x', whereas
'mean' would return rep(mean(x), 2), due to the length completion
stuff.



--
